derivation: amendment A13: rel is a case-insensitive token set, so rel=ALTERNATE is an alternate and its en_US value is one `hreflang_invalid_tag`.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="ALTERNATE" hreflang="en_US" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>

name: structure-rel-uppercase
